blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Current language-guided 3D object placement typically predicts a rigid 6-DoF pose, ignoring the physical reality that indoor placements are dictated by contact. Consequently, predicted poses often float, interpenetrate supports, or fail to deform soft surfaces. We propose Deformable Contact-Aware Placement (DCAP), a framework that reframes placement as a drop-to-equilibrium process. Rather than predicting a static pose, DCAP constructs a semantic release state that specifies the drop location, object scale, and deformable components, allowing a coupled rigid-deformable simulator to settle the object under gravity and friction. This explicitly separates semantic intent from physical realization. Evaluated on a benchmark of 2,063 prompt-asset-scene cases, DCAP significantly outperforms static baselines. On standard placements, it improves VLM Physics & Naturalness by 21.2 points and human preference by 26.5 points over the strongest raw rigid baseline, while reducing mean penetration depth by 72.3%. Compared to simulated rollout baselines, DCAP reduces residual speed by 72.1%. Ultimately, our results prove that physically accurate 3D placement requires modeling semantic intent and physical realization as strictly separate processes.
blocks.zh: 当前语言制导的3D对象布置一般预测一个刚性6-DoF的姿势,忽略了室内布置由接触决定的物理现实. 因此,预测的姿势往往漂浮、穿透式支持或无法变形软表面。 我们提议采用可变形的接触-智能定位(DCAP),这个框架将定位重新设定为滴到平衡过程。 DCAP不是预测静止的姿势,而是构建一个语义释放状态,指定了落地位置,物体尺度,以及可变构件,允许结合刚性-可变构模拟器在重力和摩擦下对物体进行定点. 这明确将语义意图与物理实现区分开来. 根据2,063个即时资产-场景的基准评估,反腐败司的业绩大大高于静态基线。 在标准布置上,它将VLM物理和自然学提高21.2分,人类偏好比最强的原始刚性基线提高26.5分,同时将平均渗透深度降低72.3. 与模拟推出基线相比,DCAP将剩余速度降低了72.1%. 归根结底,我们的结果证明,在物理上准确的3D放置需要将语义意图和物理实现作为严格独立的过程进行模型化.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language-guided 3D object placement holds strong promise for embodied AI, synthetic data generation, and virtual scene design, because it lets users arrange environments through natural-language instructions ( Savva et al., 2019 ; Kolve et al., 2017 ; Yang et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2025 ) . In the physical world, however, placement is rarely a static event. It is a dynamic interaction. Ideally, a placement system should reflect the fact that every placement is fundamentally a drop-to-equilibrium process in which an object settles until gravity, frictional contact, and material response to reach balance ( Todorov et al., 2012 ; Stomakhin et al., 2013 ; Jiang et al., 2015 ; Hu et al., 2018 ; Muller et al., 2007 ) . Such physically grounded, contact-aware placements would provide better foundations for robotic manipulation training, interactive virtual environments, and realistic scene synthesis ( Savva et al., 2019 ; Kolve et al., 2017 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 语言引导的3D对象布置对体现的AI,合成数据生成,以及虚拟场景设计有很强的希望,因为它让用户通过自然语言指令来安排环境(Savva等人,2019年;Kolve等人,2017年;Yang等人,2024a;Li等人,2025年). 然而,在物理世界中,放置很少是静态事件. 这是一种动态互动。 理想的情况是,放置系统应反映一个事实,即每个放置都从根本上是一个滴到平衡的过程,一个物体在重力、摩擦接触和物质反应之前会沉淀到平衡(Todorov等人,2012年;Stomakhin等人,2013年;Jiang等人,2015年;Hu等人,2018年;Muller等人,2007年)。 此类基于物理的、具有接触意识的布局将为机器人操纵培训、互动虚拟环境和现实的场景合成提供更好的基础(Savva等人,2019年;Kolve等人,2017年;Li等人,2025年;Lin等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Despite impressive progress in 3D-language grounding and scene understanding ( Chen et al., 2020 ; Hong et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ) , current placement models are still primarily designed for rigid, semantic-only pose prediction. Models such as PlaceIt3D and FirePlace study the problem of inserting an asset into a 3D scene by directly predicting a final 6-DoF rigid pose ( Abdelreheem et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025a ) . Yet many indoor supports such as beds, cushions, and upholstered chairs are not rigid shelves. Their deformation changes the final height, contact patch, and visible shape of the placed object ( Muller et al., 2007 ; Stomakhin et al., 2013 ; Hu et al., 2018 ) . As a result, static predictions may be physically implausible: objects may hover above fabric, fail to press into soft supports, or interpenetrate the scene geometry, which leads to failure modes that are difficult to diagnose from semantic placement alone ( Liu et al., 2021 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) . These limitations make rigid-only placement a poor fit for interactive, physics-driven simulation.
blocks.zh: 尽管在3D语言定位和场景理解上取得了令人印象深刻的进展(Chen et al.,2020;Hong et al.,2023;Zhu et al.,2024),但目前的投放模型仍然主要设计为刚性,语义唯姿势预测. PlaceIt3D和FirePlace等模型通过直接预测最终6-DoF僵硬的姿势来研究将资产插入3D场景的问题(Abdelreheem等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年a). 然而,许多室内支持,如床、垫和套座椅不是硬架。 它们变形会改变放置物体的最终高度,接触补丁,以及可见的形状(Muller等人,2007年;Stomakhin等人,2013年;Hu等人,2018年). 因此,静态预测在物理上可能不可行:物体可能徘徊在织物上方,无法压入软支撑,或者将场景几何相间,导致故障模式难以单独从语义放置中诊断(刘等人,2021年;吴等人,2024年). 这些限制使得刚性化的放置不适于交互的物理驱动模拟.

blocks.en: To bridge the gap between semantic, non-deformable placement and physically faithful 3D realization, we argue that the settling process itself must be part of the task rather than a post hoc correction. We introduce Deformable Contact-Aware Placement (DCAP), a framework for physics-aware 3D object insertion, as illustrated in Figure 1 . Given a reconstructed scene, a prompt, and an object mesh, DCAP does not directly guess the final pose. Instead, it first constructs a semantically grounded release state using language, vision, and geometry cues from modern 3D grounding and open-vocabulary perception pipelines ( Chen et al., 2020 ; Kirillov et al., 2023 ; Cheng et al., 2022 ; Peng et al., 2023 ; Jatavallabhula et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024b ) . This state identifies the support, sets the metric scale and coarse orientation, and assigns material and deformable roles. A coupled rigid–deformable simulator then lets the object settle naturally under gravity and frictional contact ( Stomakhin et al., 2013 ; Jiang et al., 2015 ; Hu et al., 2018 ; Genesis, 2025a ; Genesis, 2025b ) . This design separates what the user intended from what the physical world permits, and allows the system to return both a settled state and an interpretable feasibility flag when an instruction is physically impossible.
blocks.zh: 为了弥合语义上的,不可变形的安置和身体上的忠实的3D实现之间的差距,我们主张,和解进程本身必须是任务的一部分,而不是事后的改正. 如图1所示,我们采用了可变形的接触-智能放置(DCAP),这是物理意识3D物体插入的框架。 鉴于一个重建的场景,一个迅速,以及一个物体网格,DCAP不会直接猜测最终的姿势. 相反,它首先利用现代三维地面和开放式轨道感知管道(Chen等人,2020年;Kirillov等人,2023年;Cheng等人,2022年;Peng等人,2023年;Jatavallabhula等人,2023年;Yang等人,2024年b)的语言、视觉和几何提示来构建一个模拟的释放状态。 这种状态可以识别支持,设定尺度和粗糙的方向,并分配物质和可变形的角色. 结合的刚性-变形模拟器则让物体在重力和摩擦接触下自然沉淀(Stomakhin等人,2013年;Jiang等人,2015年;Hu等人,2018年;Genesis,2025a;Genesis,2025b). 这种设计将用户的意图与物理世界允许的区分开来,并允许系统在某项指令实际上不可能时返回一个已解决状态和可解释的可行性旗.

blocks.en: The separation is useful in three ways. First, compliant supports and deformable objects become natural cases rather than special cases. The final pose is produced by material response, not by a rigid correction. Second, failure becomes a valid output. If the support is too narrow, the object is too large, or the motion does not converge, the system can reject the placement instead of returning an implausible pose. Third, the method exposes physical diagnostics that are difficult to see in a few renderings. They measure penetration, contact, residual motion, and target drift. Such diagnostics complement human and VLM judgments, which are useful but can miss physical errors hidden in geometry or dynamics ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Tam et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 分别用三义. 首先,符合要求的支持和可变形物体成为自然案例,而不是特殊案例。 最后的姿势是由物质反应产生的,而不是通过僵硬的校正. 第二,失败成为有效的输出. 如果支持太窄,对象太大,或者运动不趋同,系统可以拒绝放置,而不是返回一个不可信的姿势. 第三,这种方法暴露了在少数渲染中难以见到的物理诊断. 它们测量渗透、接触、剩余运动和目标漂移。 这种诊断补充了人类判断和VLM判断,这些判断是有用的,但可能错过隐藏在几何或动态中的物理错误(Wu等人,2024年;Tam等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Contributions : 1) We formulate language-guided 3D object placement as release-state planning followed by drop-to-equilibrium settling; 2) We introduce DCAP, a modular pipeline that combines language/vision grounding with rigid–deformable simulation; 3) We build a benchmark of simulation-ready indoor scenes paired with placement prompts and rigid or deformable assets; 4) We evaluate placement along semantic and physical axes, with objective diagnostics, ablations, submodule checks, and failure analysis.
blocks.zh: 贡献:1)我们制定语言指导的三维对象放置方案,作为释放状态规划,然后进行滴落到平衡沉淀; 2) 我们引入了DCAP,一个模块化的管道,将语言/视觉地面与刚性-可变模拟相结合;3) 我们构建一个模拟准备室内场景的基准,配以放置提示和刚性或可变资产;4) 我们评价按语义和物理轴进行布置,并配有客观的诊断,分模块检查和故障分析.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Language-guided 3D placement, grounding, and layout. Language-guided placement connects a prompt to a support, a region, an orientation, and a set of spatial constraints. PlaceIt3D and FirePlace study this problem directly for asset insertion into real or reconstructed scenes ( Abdelreheem et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025a ) . Broader 3D-language and layout methods use LLMs, VLMs, scene graphs, differentiable optimization, or embodied-scene priors to arrange objects in 3D ( Hong et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025b ; Feng et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024a ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Ran et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . These methods are valuable because they provide semantic intent and approximate geometry. DCAP uses the same kind of grounding signal, including replaceable open-vocabulary segmentation backends ( Chen et al., 2020 ; Kirillov et al., 2023 ; Cheng et al., 2022 ; Peng et al., 2023 ; Jatavallabhula et al., 2023 ) . The difference is where these signals enter the problem. In DCAP, they define a release state. The final pose is resolved by contact and compliance.
blocks.zh: 语言导3D布置,地面布局. 语言引导的布局将一个提示与一个支持,一个区域,一个方向,以及一组空间约束联系起来. PlaceIt3D和FirePlace直接研究这一问题,以便将资产插入到真实或重建的场景中(Abdelreheem等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年a). Broader 3D语言和布局方法使用LLMs,VLM,场景图,异样优化,或体现-场景前传,以安排3D的物体(Hong等人,2023年;Zhu等人,2024年;Huang等人,2025年b;Feng等人,2023年;Yang等人,2024年a;Sun等人,2025年;Ran等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年)。 这些方法很有价值,因为它们提供了语义意图和近似几何. DCAP使用同一种地面信号,包括可替换的开放-伏浮区段后端(Chen等人,2020年;Kirillov等人,2023年;Cheng等人,2022年;Peng等人,2023年;Jatavallabhula等人,2023年). 区别在于这些信号进入问题所在. 在DCAP中,它们定义了释放状态. 最终的姿势通过接触和遵守来解决.

blocks.en: Scene resources and visual object insertion. Large indoor reconstructions and object repositories have enabled progress in scene understanding, embodied navigation, environment generation, and asset insertion ( Dai et al., 2017 ; Chang et al., 2017 ; Ramakrishnan et al., 2021 ; Xia et al., 2018 ; Savva et al., 2019 ; Kolve et al., 2017 ; Deitke et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024b ) . These resources are often designed for perception or rendering, not for deformable contact. Image-space and 3DGS insertion methods further improve visual plausibility through appearance matching, shadows, relighting, or multi-view consistency ( Liu et al., 2021 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , complementary to DCAP. A visually plausible insertion can still be physically invalid, and a settled 3D state can later be rendered with stronger image-space tools. Our benchmark therefore focuses on the requirements of physical placement, including metric scale, usable support geometry, material labels, and contact diagnostics.
blocks.zh: 场景资源和视觉对象插入. 大型室内重建和物体储存库使得在了解现场方面取得进展,包括导航、环境生成和资产插入(Dai等人,2017年;Chang等人,2017年;Ramakrishnan等人,2021年;Xia等人,2018年;Savva等人,2019年;Kolve等人,2017年;Deitke等人,2023年;Yang等人,2024年b)。 这些资源往往用于感知或渲染,而不是用于变形的接触. 图像空间和3DGS插入方法通过外观匹配,阴影,重燃,或多视图一致性(刘等人,2021年;朱等人,2023年;李等人,2025年)进一步提高视觉可信度,补充DCAP. 一个视觉上可行的插入仍然在物理上是无效的,一个已解决的3D状态在以后可以通过更强大的图像空间工具来渲染. 因此,我们的基准侧重于物理定位的要求,包括度量尺度、可用支持几何、材料标签和接触诊断。

blocks.en: Physical simulation and diagnostic evaluation. Frictional contact and deformation are standard topics in MPM, PBD, and rigid-body simulation ( Stomakhin et al., 2013 ; Jiang et al., 2015 ; Hu et al., 2018 ; Muller et al., 2007 ; Todorov et al., 2012 ; Makoviychuk et al., 2021 ; Genesis, 2025b ; Genesis, 2025a ; NVIDIA, 2025 ) . MPM is a natural fit for compliant placement because particles represent soft material while a background grid transfers stress and contact. Rigid-body engines remain efficient for stiff components and mature collision handling. Recent physics-augmented scene generation also uses simulation to improve equilibrium and non-intersection, but it mainly targets rigid scene-level generation rather than deformable insertion into a fixed reconstruction ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . DCAP combines these views by simulating soft or contact-critical parts deformably while keeping stiff components rigid. For evaluation, we pair human and VLM judgments with direct measurements of contact, motion, and convergence ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Tam et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 物理模拟与诊断评价. 硬体接触和变形是MPM,PBD和刚体模拟的标准主题(Stomakhin等人,2013年;Jiang等人,2015年;Hu等人,2018年;Muller等人,2007年;Todorov等人,2012年;Makoviychuk等人,2021年;Genesis,2025b;Genesis,2025a;NVIDIA,2025年). MPM是符合性放置的自然适合,因为颗粒代表软材料,而背景网格则转移应力和接触. 硬体发动机对于坚硬的部件和成熟的碰撞处理仍然有效率. 近期的物理增强场景生成也使用模拟来改善均衡性和非交互性,但它主要针对的是僵硬的场景级生成,而不是可变形插入固定重建(Lin等人,2026年). DCAP通过模拟软或接触关键部件变形,同时保持僵硬的部件僵硬,将这些观点结合起来. 为了评估,我们将人类判断和VLM判断与直接测量接触、运动和趋同(Wu等人,2024年;Tam等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Given z 0 z_{0} , DCAP computes the final outcome through a rigid–deformable rollout y = Γ ⁡ ( z 0 , S , M O , 𝐠 ) , y=\Gamma(z_{0};S,M_{O},\mathbf{g}), where Γ \Gamma denotes the simulator and diagnostic operator, and 𝐠 \mathbf{g} is the gravity vector. The rollout applies the scale s s , initializes the object at ( R 0 , 𝐭 0 ) (R_{0},\mathbf{t}_{0}) , couples rigid bodies with deformable MPM particles, and simulates contact under gravity and friction. It terminates when the system reaches equilibrium or when the maximum simulation horizon is reached. Equilibrium is detected using velocity, center-of-mass drift, and bounding-box change thresholds over a fixed convergence window. Appendix F gives thresholds and simulator settings. We avoid treating rollout as post-processing correction: its output is the physical realization of the release state.

blocks.en: 4.1 Semantic Grounding and Scene Decomposition
blocks.zh: 4.1 语义定位和场面分解

blocks.en: Because physics-based simulation is acutely sensitive to metric scale and boundary constraints, DCAP first establishes a formal mapping between semantic intent and the reconstructed scene. We leverage the common-sense reasoning of a large language model (LLM) to extract the intended support category b b and a realistic longest-dimension prior from the instruction p p . By isotropically rescaling the object mesh to match this category-level size prior, we obtain metric collision geometry and an approximate volume scale for simulation. Mass and inertia are then approximated from the scaled geometry together with the material parameters in θ \theta . Given the identified support category b b , the system then locates the specific support instance S b S_{b} and decomposes it into semantic parts P b P_{b} (Figure 1 , Steps 1–3). We follow a standard 2D-to-3D open-vocabulary pipeline to segment the scene into semantic parts (e.g., mattress vs. frame) ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ; Cheng et al., 2022 ; Peng et al., 2023 ; Jatavallabhula et al., 2023 ) . Beyond visually grounding the prompt, this decomposition establishes material properties to restrict expensive deformable simulation only to necessary regions.

blocks.en: 4.2 Release Pose Initialization
blocks.zh: 4.2 释放Pose初始化

blocks.en: With the object scaled and the scene segmented, the next step is to define the release pose ( R 0 , 𝐭 0 ) (R_{0},\mathbf{t}_{0}) . Natural language often provides only coarse orientation cues, such as a mug handle facing outward. To efficiently resolve this angular ambiguity, DCAP renders three prompt-conditioned orientation candidates created by 180-degree flips about canonical object axes and uses a vision-language model (VLM) to select the best semantic match (Figure 1 , Step 4). This stage resolves only coarse semantic orientation, and the rollout handles small contact-induced pose adjustments rather than performing a continuous semantic orientation search. To determine the precise release translation 𝐭 0 \mathbf{t}_{0} , we utilize a geometric ray-cast anchoring mechanism. The system maps the prompt to a target part π \pi and an anchor a a and then casts a ray along the gravity direction to identify the corresponding physical point on the support surface (Figure 1 , Step 5). To ensure numerical stability and provide sufficient headroom for gravitational settling, the object is initialized with a small positive vertical clearance δ > 0 \delta>0 (specified in Appendix F ) above the target surface. This guarantees that the settling process is driven entirely by physical mechanics rather than artificial forces from initial mesh interpenetration.
blocks.zh: 随着对象的缩放和场景的分割,下一步是定义释放姿势(R 0,t 0) (R_{0},\mathb{t}_{0}). 自然语言往往只提供粗糙的定向提示,如杯柄面对外向. 为了有效解决这个角模糊性,DCAP让三个由180度翻转而创造的关于犬形物体轴的快速条件定向候选人,并使用视觉语言模型(VLM)来选择最好的语义匹配(图1,步骤4). 这个阶段只解决粗语义导向,推出处理小接触引起的摆设调整,而不是进行连续的语义定向搜索. 为了确定准确的发布翻译 t 0\ mathbf{t}_{0},我们使用几何射线播报锚定机制. 系统将提示映射到目标部分 \\\ pi 和一个锚,然后沿着重力方向投射一条射线,以识别支持表面的相应物理点(图1,步骤5)。 为确保数值稳定性和为重力沉淀提供足够的头室,该物体在目标表面上方以小的正垂直清点 + > 0\delta>0(在附录F中注明)。 这保证了安顿过程完全由物理力学驱动,而不是由最初的网间穿插产生的人为力量.

blocks.en: 4.3 Material Assignment and Particle Discretization
blocks.zh: 4.3 材料转让和颗粒分离

blocks.en: To balance simulation fidelity with computational efficiency, DCAP must assign physical roles to the parsed geometric parts. Instead of learning continuous material parameters, we map each semantic part to a discrete material ID from a curated library, which provides the density, elastic modulus, and friction parameters collected in θ \theta (Figure 1 , Step 6). Compliant materials (foam, fabric, mattresses) are assigned to 𝒟 \mathcal{D} and stiff materials (wood, metal, frames) are assigned to ℛ \mathcal{R} . Simulating only compliant parts (e.g., cushions) deformably while keeping stiff frames rigid drastically reduces compute without sacrificing contact fidelity. Once compliant parts are identified, they must be discretized into MPM particles (Figure 1 , Step 7). Uniform voxel filling often catastrophically under-samples thin indoor surfaces, such as blankets, rendering the geometry numerically fragile and incapable of resolving frictional contact. As illustrated in Figure 2 , for a surface point 𝐱 \mathbf{x} , DCAP estimates the local thickness t ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) t(\mathbf{x}) along the surface normal and adapts the particle spacing h ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) h(\mathbf{x}) . The constant k min = 3 k_{\min}=3 is the required minimum number of particle layers through the local thickness. This targeted discretization, bounded by a global particle cap, ensures even thin compliant regions can realistically carry stress and deform naturally.
blocks.zh: 为了平衡模拟忠诚度与计算效率,DCAP必须将物理角色分配给解析几何部分. 我们不是学习连续的材料参数,而是将每个语义部分映射到一个来自被整理的库的离散材料ID,该库提供了收集在\theta(图1,步骤6)中的密度,弹性模具和摩擦参数. 粘合材料(泡沫,织物,床垫)被分配到D\mathcal{D},僵硬材料(木材,金属,框架)被分配到R\mathcal{R}. 只模拟符合要求的部件(如衬垫)会变形,同时保持僵硬的帧会大大降低计算,同时又不牺牲接触忠诚。 一旦识别出符合要求的部件,就必须将其盘片化为MPM粒子(图1,步骤7)。 统一的瓶装往往具有灾难性的底样薄薄的室内表面,如毯子,使几何数字脆弱,无法解决摩擦接触. 如图2所示,对于一个表面点 x\ mathbf{x}, DCAP 估计沿表面正常运行的局部厚度 t & (x) t (\mathbf{x}) 并调整粒子间距 h & (x) h (\mathbf{x}) 。 常数 k min = 3 k_{\min}=3,是通过局部厚度所需的粒子层的最低数量. 这种以全球粒子封顶为界的定向盘点化,确保了甚至瘦小的达标区域能够现实地承受压力和自然变形。

blocks.en: 4.4 Drop-to-Equilibrium Simulation and Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 4.4 滴到平衡模拟和诊断

blocks.en: The final stage is where placement becomes physics. The object is released from ( R 0 , 𝐭 0 ) (R_{0},\mathbf{t}_{0}) , allowing rigid bodies and MPM particles to interact through frictional contact until the strict convergence criteria from Section 3 are met or the maximum horizon is reached (Figure 1 , Steps 8–10). The rollout outputs the final transform, the deformed scene geometry, and an array of physical diagnostics including residual motion, contact ratios, and a feasibility flag. Crucially, rather than collapsing uncertainty into an opaque score, DCAP propagates module-level confidence and diagnostic flags. Low-confidence or invalid module outputs trigger deterministic fallback rules before simulation such as scale clamping, canonical stable-orientation selection, default material assignment, and particle-budget coarsening. These fallback events are recorded as diagnostic flags; Appendix E lists the exact triggers and recovery rules. If the object leaves the target support, fails to converge, or violates tolerances, the system marks the case as infeasible and explicitly categorizes the error source (perception, geometry, materials, or physics).
blocks.zh: 最后阶段是放置成为物理学。 该物体由(R 00,t 0)释放(R_{0},\mathbf{t}_{0}),允许刚性体和MPM颗粒通过摩擦接触进行相互作用,直到符合第3节严格的趋同标准或达到最大视野(图1,步骤8–10). 推展输出了最终变形,变形场景几何,以及一系列物理诊断,包括剩余运动,接触比,以及可行性旗. 关键的是,DCAP没有将不确定性破解成不透明的分数,而是宣传模块层面的信心和诊断旗帜。 低自信或无效的模块输出在模拟前触发了确定性的倒置规则,如缩放夹击、犬类稳定定向选择、默认物质分配和粒子预算凝固。 这些倒转事件被记录为诊断旗;附录E列出了确切的触发和恢复规则. 如果物体离开目标支持,未能汇合,或违反容性,系统将情况标记为不可行的,并明确划分出错误源(认知,几何,材料,或物理).

blocks.en: 5 Experiments and Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 实验和分析

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Unlike existing semantic-only placement benchmarks such as PlaceIt3D ( Abdelreheem et al., 2025 ) , evaluating DCAP requires physics-ready geometry. We construct a benchmark of 2,063 prompt–asset–scene cases drawn from 186 high-fidelity indoor reconstructions and 155 object assets ( Dai et al., 2017 ; Chang et al., 2017 ; Ramakrishnan et al., 2021 ; Xia et al., 2018 ; Deitke et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024b ) . To support rigorous contact queries and physical rollouts, we process scenes via TSDF fusion and screened-Poisson meshing to guarantee the watertight, metric surfaces required for physical simulation ( Curless and Levoy, 1996 ; Kazhdan et al., 2006 ; Kazhdan and Hoppe, 2013 ) . This pipeline preserves metric accuracy and provides watertight surfaces suitable for simulation. We evaluate all methods on two distinct splits. The standard split contains 1,923 cases and serves as the primary testbed for aggregate placement quality, human/VLM preference, and physical diagnostics. It is further diversified by contact regime, with 869 soft-contact, 550 mixed-contact, and 504 rigid-contact cases. The stress split contains 140 cases and is used specifically to evaluate robustness and feasibility handling. It includes 64 out-of-distribution feasible prompts and 76 annotated physically impossible prompts. Correct rejections on this split count only toward feasibility metrics, while any returned feasible placements receive the standard diagnostics. Appendix G documents the construction log and reporting denominators.
blocks.zh: 与PlaceIt3D(Abdelreheem等人,2025年)等现有的唯语义放置基准不同,评价DCAP需要物理准备几何. 我们从186个高纯度室内重建项目和155个实物资产(戴等人,2017年;张等人,2017年;Ramakrishnan等人,2021年;Xia等人,2018年;Deitke等人,2023年;Yang等人,2024年b)中构建了2,063个快速-资产-场景案例的基准. 为了支持严格的接触询问和物理推广,我们通过TSDF聚变和筛选-Poisson meshing处理场景,以保证物理模拟所需的水密、度量表面(Curless和Levoy,1996年;Kazhdan等人,2006年;Kazhdan和Hoppe,2013年)。 这种管道保持了公制精度,并提供了适合模拟的紧水面. 我们用两种不同的方法来评估所有方法。 标准划分包含1,923个病例,并作为总体安置质量、人/VLM偏好和物理诊断的主要测试床。 它通过接触制度进一步多样化,有869个软接触型,550个混合接触型,504个刚性接触型. 压力分担包括140个案件,专门用于评价处理稳健性和可行性。 它包括64个分配外可行的提示和76个附加说明的物理上不可能提示。 正确的拒绝只计算可行性指标,而任何返回的可行安置都得到标准诊断。 附 录 G记录施工记录和报告分母。

blocks.en: To isolate the impact of our physics-aware formulation, we benchmark against both existing state-of-the-art models and internally controlled variants. To ensure a fair comparison, all methods receive the same prompt, object scale, scene mesh, and camera views. The raw static baselines are FirePlace, PlaceIt3D, LayoutGPT, and Holodeck ( Huang et al., 2025a ; Abdelreheem et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024a ) . Because these models output purely static poses, dynamic metrics such as residual speed and convergence are undefined for them. We also evaluate controlled physics variants to untangle the value of the initial release state from the physical settling process. FirePlace + rigid and FirePlace + deformable use FirePlace’s static prediction as the initialization for rigid or deformable settling. Conversely, DCAP static (init+snap) tests the upstream language–vision–geometry planner as a static method by replacing the physics simulator with a naive gravity-axis snap. This geometric snap translates the object only along the gravity axis until it reaches the closest non-penetrating contact with the selected support. It does not simulate in a physics engine. Finally, DCAP rigid-only runs the full pipeline while treating all materials as rigid during rollout. Appendix I gives baseline adaptation details.
blocks.zh: 为了孤立我们的物理认知配方的影响,我们参照现有最先进的模型和内部控制的变体。 为了确保公平比较,所有方法都得到同样的即时,对象尺度,场景网,以及相机视图. 原始静态基线有FirePlace、PlaceIT3D、布局GPT和Holodeck(黄等人,2025a;Abdelreheem等人,2025年;冯等人,2023年;杨等人,2024a年)。 因为这些模型输出纯粹是静态的姿势,所以对于这些模型来说,剩余速度和趋同等动态度量标准没有定义. 我们还评估受控制的物理变体,以将初始释放状态的价值与物理沉淀过程解开。 FirePlace + 刚性与FirePlace + 变形使用 FirePlace 的静态预测作为刚性或变形沉淀的初始化. 反之,DCAP静态(init+snap)将上游语言-视觉-几何规划器作为静态方法进行测试,用天真的重力轴断裂取代物理模拟器。 这个几何坐标速记只沿着重力轴翻译对象,直到它与选定的支持到达最接近的非穿透接触. 它不模拟在物理引擎。 最后,DCAP刚性地运行整个管道,同时在推出过程中将所有材料视为刚性. 附 录 我给出了基线适应细节。

blocks.en: We assess placement success along two complementary dimensions, subjective visual plausibility and objective physical stability. Human evaluators and the VLM compare results along two axes. Right Place (RP) measures semantic accuracy by asking whether the object is on the correct support, in the intended region, and oriented consistently with the prompt. Physics & Naturalness (P/N) measures physical plausibility, so a high score requires stable support, realistic contact, material-consistent deformation, and absence of floating or deep interpenetration. Bradley–Terry–Luce estimates are derived from 2,520 preference trials with 42 retained participants, with 420 attention-check trials excluded from aggregation. Our objective physical diagnostics explicitly measure mesh penetration depth, not valid soft-support indentation, support contact ratio, residual motion, target adherence, and simulator convergence. Physical diagnostics are reported only for methods that run an explicit rollout. Appendices J , K , and L provide the full evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个相辅相成的方面来评估放置的成功,即主观的视觉可信性和客观的物理稳定性。 人类评价员与VLM按照两个轴线比较结果. Right Place(RP)通过询问对象在预定区域是否在正确的支持上,并且与提示一致定向来测量语义准确性. 物理与自然(P/N)测量物理的可信度,因此高分要求稳定的支持,现实的接触,物质的一致变形,以及没有浮或深的互通. Bradley-Terry-Luce的估计数来自2 520次优惠试验,42人保留,420次注意力检查试验被排除在汇总之外。 我们的客观物理诊断明确测量网格穿透深度,没有有效的软支撑缩进,支持接触比,剩余运动,目标坚持,模拟器趋同. 物理诊断只用于明确推出的方法。 附录J,K,L提供了完整的评价协议.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Comparison and Controlled Variants
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要比较和控制的变式

blocks.en: Table 2 gives the main comparison, with qualitative examples in Figure 4 and representative settling sequences in Figure 3 . DCAP significantly outperforms existing static baselines across all placement and physical metrics. Compared with FirePlace, the strongest raw static baseline in our setting, DCAP raises the VLM Physics & Naturalness (P/N) score from 64.0 to 85.2 and the human P/N preference score from 50.1 to 76.6. Crucially, it reduces the mean penetration depth from 1.48 cm to 0.41 cm and increases valid support contact from 0.65 to 0.89. To understand where these gains come from, we isolate the two core components of our pipeline, the initial release state and the physical settling process. The controlled variants reveal that both precise initialization and dynamic physical rollout are strictly necessary. The first comparison shows that physical simulation cannot fix a bad initialization. Adding a settling process to the FirePlace baseline improves its performance, and deformable settling helps more than rigid settling. However, FirePlace + deformable still significantly underperforms full DCAP, which isolates the value of our release state. A physics simulator cannot correct an object that is dropped on the wrong part of a surface, oriented incorrectly, or scaled to an implausible size. The reverse comparison makes the complementary point. When we use DCAP’s strong initialization but replace the physics engine with a simple geometric snap (DCAP static), the result is highly competitive with raw static baselines and drastically reduces penetration. Yet its contact ratio and physical naturalness remain limited. A geometric snap can close a gap, but it cannot create a broad contact patch, simulate frictional resting, or deform a soft support. Together, these results explain why we evaluate semantic placement, Right Place (RP), and physical plausibility, Physics & Naturalness (P/N), as separate metrics. Correct spatial coordinates do not guarantee a correct physical state. A method can place a dumbbell at the center of a mattress and still fail if the mattress does not compress, or place a plush toy on the correct sofa cushion and still fail if it floats. Ultimately, these are not just different target coordinates; they are different physical states.
blocks.zh: 表2主要比较了图4中的定性例子和图3中的代表性结算顺序。 在所有放置和物理测量中,DCAP的绩效大大超过现有的静态基线。 与FirePlace相比,我们环境中最强的原始静态基线,DCAP将VLM物理与自然(P/N)分数从64.0提高到85.2,人类P/N偏好分数从50.1提高到76.6. 关键是将平均穿透深度从1.48厘米降低到0.41厘米,并将有效支持接触从0.65增加到0.89. 为了了解这些成果来自何处,我们孤立了我们管道的两个核心部分,即初始释放状态和物理沉淀过程。 受控变体显示,精确初始化和动态物理推出都是绝对必要的. 第一次比较表明物理模拟不能修复不良的初始化. 在FirePlace基线中添加一个结算程序可以提高它的性能,可变的结算比僵硬的结算更有帮助. 然而,FirePlace +可变形体仍然明显表现不佳的完全DCAP,这隔离了我们释放状态的值. 一个物理模拟器无法校正一个投落在表面错误部分,方向不正确,或缩放到不可相信大小的物体. 反向比较是相辅相成的。 当我们使用 DCAP 的强初始化,但用简单的几何断裂( DCAP 静态)取代物理引擎时,结果与原始的静态基线竞争非常激烈,并大幅降低渗透率. 然而,它的接触比率和自然性仍然有限。 几何突起可以关闭一个缺口,但不能产生宽的接触补丁,模拟摩擦休息,或变形软支持. 这些结果共同解释了我们为什么将语义定位、正确位置(RP)和物理可信度、物理和自然性(P/N)作为单独的衡量标准。 正确的空间坐标并不能保证正确的物理状态. 一种方法可以在床垫中央放置哑铃,如果床垫不压缩,仍会失败,或者在正确的沙发衬垫上放置一个加的玩具,如果浮起来,仍会失败. 归根结底,这些不仅仅是不同的目标坐标;它们是不同的物理状态。

blocks.en: 5.3 Regime, Feasibility, and Human Validation
blocks.zh: 5.3 制度、可行性和人类验证

blocks.en: The strongest gains occur on soft supports like beds and sofas, where DCAP achieves an 88.2 P/N score compared to 60.4 for raw FirePlace and 74.7 for rigid-only DCAP (Tables 3 and 4 ). On these compliant surfaces, final height and contact are dictated by mass, stiffness, and friction rather than original mesh geometry alone. Rigid supports provide a natural control. Here, full DCAP and its rigid-only variant perform similarly, though the full pipeline remains robust due to strict convergence and feasibility checks. Beyond spatial accuracy, the stress split proves DCAP can reliably reject physically invalid prompts (0.83 F1) while accepting 52 of 64 feasible out-of-distribution cases. Human evaluations echo this physical robustness, showing a 26.5-point BTL preference over raw FirePlace in physical naturalness. Crucially, comparing full and rigid-only DCAP reveals an 8.6-point gap in naturalness (P/N) but only a 0.7-point gap in spatial accuracy (RP). This proves that deformable settling enhances realism without displacing the object from its semantic target. Ultimately, the strong alignment across human preference, VLM scoring, and objective diagnostics confirms that our gains are physically grounded rather than merely cosmetic.
blocks.zh: 在床和沙发等软支持上,得分最大,因为DCAP的得分为88.2P/N,而原始FirePlace的得分为60.4,而刚性仅限DCAP的得分为74.7(表3和表4)。 在这些符合要求的表面,最终的高度和接触是由质量、坚硬性和摩擦决定的,而不是仅由原始的网状几何来决定的。 刚性支持提供自然控制. 在这方面,完全的DCAP及其刚性化的变体也具有类似的作用,尽管由于严格的趋同和可行性检查,整个管道仍然很坚固。 除了空间精确性以外,压力分解证明DCAP可以可靠地拒绝物理无效的提示(0.83 F1),同时接受64个可行的分配外案例中的52个. 人类评价反应了这种物理稳健性,显示出在物理自然性上比原始FirePlace偏好26.5分BTL. 关键是,比较完全和刚性只差的DCAP揭示出自然性(P/N)8.6分的差距,但空间精确度(RP)只有0.7分的差距. 这证明了可变形的沉淀可以增强现实主义,而不会使物体脱离其语义目标. 最终,人类偏好、VLM评分和客观诊断之间的紧密一致证实了我们的成果是建立在实际基础上的,而不仅仅是表面的。

blocks.en: 5.4 Ablations, Runtime, and Failure Modes
blocks.zh: 5.4 故障、运行时间和故障模式

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that robust physical simulation strictly depends on accurate upstream data. Degrading geometric fidelity by removing thin-aware filling drops the P/N score to 76.3 because coarse particles cannot support stable contact. Material precision is equally critical. Substituting generic defaults (78.0 P/N) or rigid supports (74.5 P/N) severely cripples the ability to model compliant deformation. Furthermore, physics engines cannot fix wrong semantic targets. Our fallback rules are therefore essential for mitigating inevitable perception errors and preventing hard failures from spiking (0.184 vs. 0.039). Given the 107.5-second average runtime bottlenecked by simulation, this performance profile points to a practical cascade that we can deploy fast rigid placement for stiff scenes and reserve expensive deformable settling for soft materials or uncertain contacts. Appendices E – O detail further submodule checks and rollouts.
blocks.zh: 表5显示,强健的物理模拟严格依赖于准确的上游数据. 通过去除薄的知觉填充来降解几何忠诚度将P/N分数降至76.3,因为粗细的颗粒无法支持稳定的接触. 材料精度同样至关重要。 取代通用默认值(78.0 P/N)或刚性支持值(74.5 P/N)严重削弱了模拟符合变形的能力. 此外,物理引擎无法修复错误的语义目标. 因此,我们的倒置规则对于减轻不可避免的感知错误和防止硬性失败激增至关重要(0.184 vs.0.039)。 鉴于模拟所束缚的平均运行时间为107.5秒,这一性能概况表明,我们可采用实用的级联,为僵硬的场景部署快速僵硬的布置,并为软材料或不确定的接触保留昂贵的变形安置。 附录 E – O 细节 进一步的子模块检查和推出.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: While DCAP establishes 3D placement as a physical drop-to-equilibrium process, its robustness is inherently bounded by current simulation constraints. Our material library relies on simplified isotropic parameters, and placement fidelity is strictly bottlenecked by the quality of upstream geometry reconstruction. Furthermore, while humans and VLMs excel at assessing visual plausibility, they often overlook subtle physical violations that only objective metrics capture. Bridging these gaps will require future benchmarks that incorporate real-world physical validation for complex, deformable household materials. Despite these limitations, our coupled rigid-deformable pipeline significantly outperforms static baselines, demonstrating that realistic resting states cannot be recovered by 6-DoF pose estimation alone. Ultimately, this work highlights a fundamental truth for embodied scene synthesis. Assigned spatial coordinates are not a substitute for physical realization, and being in the right place is never the same as being physically placed.
blocks.zh: 虽然DCAP将3D定位设定为物理滴到平衡过程,但其稳健性内在受当前模拟约束的约束. 我们的材料库依赖于简化的异构参数,放置忠贞性严格地受到上游几何重建质量的束缚. 此外,虽然人类和VLM在评估视觉可信度方面表现优异,但它们往往忽略了只有客观衡量标准才能捕捉到的微妙身体侵犯。 弥合这些差距需要今后制定基准,其中包括对复杂、可变形的家庭材料进行实际验证。 尽管存在这些局限性,我们刚性变质的管道的绩效大大超过静态基线,表明仅靠6-DoF无法恢复现实的休息状态。 这部作品最终凸显了体现的场景合成的基本真理. 指定的空间坐标不能代替物理实现,在正确的位置上与被物理放置永远是不一样的.

blocks.en: D.1 Scene Segmentation

blocks.en: The reported implementation renders 48 RGB-D views per scene for semantic transfer, sampled from the 120 reconstruction views in Appendix G . We extract OpenScene features on the mesh, run Segment Anything ViT-H on the rendered RGB frames, and use Mask2Former panoptic labels as category priors. Image masks are projected to visible mesh triangles with z-buffer tests. Each triangle receives the visibility-weighted majority label, and each support instance receives a confidence equal to the mean projected-mask score multiplied by the fraction of visible supporting votes. The default confidence threshold is 0.55. Synonyms such as couch/sofa or bed/mattress are resolved through a fixed taxonomy. If the intended support is not found, DCAP retries with synonyms and then falls back to the largest upward-facing support surface.

blocks.en: Given the base instance, a category-conditional vocabulary defines the support parts. If a learned part segmenter is unavailable, geometric heuristics propose candidate parts from planar clustering, connectivity, and local orientation. These candidates are then labeled with the constrained vocabulary. Base-instance success is counted when the selected support overlaps the verified support instance with triangle IoU at least 0.25 or the selected anchor lies inside the verified support mask. Part success is counted when the selected target part overlaps the verified part with triangle IoU at least 0.20, or when the final anchor is within 10 cm of the verified target region. Verification uses the benchmark support and part annotations fixed before running any method. Table 9 reports the resulting segmentation and decomposition rates.

blocks.en: This appendix documents how the deformable placement benchmark was constructed. The goal is not only to collect meaningful prompts. Each case must also contain the information needed for contact evaluation. This includes metric scale and usable support geometry. It also includes a valid object mesh and enough semantics to assign parts, materials, and feasibility labels. All prompt–asset–scene triples are fixed before running any method. All baselines use the same triples and scales. They also use the same scene geometry, camera views, and prompts.
blocks.zh: 本附录记录了可变形放置基准的构建方式. 目标不仅仅是收集有意义的提示。 每种情况还必须包括联系评估所需的资料。 这包括测量尺度和可用支持几何。 它还包括一个有效的对象网和足够的语义来指定零件,材料,和可行性标签. 所有快速- 资产- 场景三重机在运行任何方法前都会被固定 。 所有基线都使用相同的三重和尺度。 他们还使用相同的场景几何,相机视图,和提示.

blocks.en: We start from 214 high-fidelity indoor reconstructions drawn from existing indoor scene resources and embodied-environment datasets ( Dai et al., 2017 ; Chang et al., 2017 ; Ramakrishnan et al., 2021 ; Xia et al., 2018 ; Savva et al., 2019 ; Kolve et al., 2017 ) . Object assets come from diverse 3D repositories, including Objaverse-style assets and part-oriented assets when available ( Deitke et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024b ) . We keep meshes with identifiable category labels, plausible metric scale after normalization, and geometry suitable for rendering and collision queries. The final benchmark uses 186 simulation-ready scenes and 155 object assets.
blocks.zh: 我们从现有室内景物资源和内涵环境数据集抽取的214个高纯度室内重建开始(Dai等人,2017年;Chang等人,2017年;Ramakrishnan等人,2021年;霞等人,2018年;Savva等人,2019年;Kolve等人,2017年). 对象资产来自不同的3D寄存器,包括Objaverse风格的资产和可用时的半导向资产(Deitke等人,2023年;Yang等人,2024年b). 我们保留了可识别的分类标签、正常化后可行的度量尺度以及适合渲染和碰撞查询的几何图形。 最终基准使用186个模拟准备场景和155个物体资产.

blocks.en: Each source scene is converted to a simulation-ready mesh with a deterministic post-processing pipeline. We render 120 RGB-D views per scene on a hemispherical indoor camera path. The depth observations are fused into a volumetric representation, and a mesh is extracted with screened Poisson reconstruction at 2 cm nominal resolution ( Curless and Levoy, 1996 ; Kazhdan et al., 2006 ; Kazhdan and Hoppe, 2013 ) . We then remove small disconnected components, fill bounded holes, check scale consistency, and transfer semantic labels when available. The same mesh is used by all methods for rendering, surface projection, collision checks, and physical diagnostics. Table 15 summarizes the conversion and quality-control settings.
blocks.zh: 每个源场景都转换成模拟准备的网格,并配有确定性的处理后管道. 我们在西半球室内摄像路 拍摄120个RGB-D 深度观测被结合成一个体积表示,并用经过筛选的Poisson重建的网格以2厘米的名义分辨率提取(Curless和Levoy,1996年;Kazhdan等人,2006年;Kazhdan和Hoppe,2013年)。 然后,我们去除小的断开组件,填充边框孔,检查比例一致性,并在可用时传输语义标签. 所有方法都使用同一网格进行渲染、表面投影、碰撞检查和物理诊断。 表15概述了转换和质量控制设置。

blocks.en: Table 15: Mesh conversion and quality-control log.
blocks.zh: 表15:网格转换和质量控制记录。

blocks.en: A scene is accepted only if at least one target support category can be localized with enough geometry for contact evaluation. We reject scenes with ambiguous scale or damaged target regions. We also reject scenes with floaters near likely contacts, fragmented support geometry, or missing prompt supports. We also exclude scenes where semantic transfer prevents reliable support or part selection after synonym fallback. These filters are stricter than rendering-only filters because small geometric defects can dominate contact diagnostics.
blocks.zh: 一个场景只有在至少有一个目标支持类别能够本地化,足够几何来进行接触评价的情况下才会被接受. 我们拒绝范围模糊或目标区域受损的场景。 我们还拒绝用浮标接近可能接触的场景, 零碎的支持几何, 或缺失的即时支持。 我们还排除了语义转移在同义词倒置后阻碍可靠支持或部分选择的场景. 这些滤波器比纯渲染滤波器更严格,因为小几何缺陷可以支配接触诊断.

blocks.en: The benchmark covers common indoor supports across soft, mixed, and rigid contact. Beds and sofas emphasize compliant surfaces. Chairs and carpets create mixed contacts. Shelves, tables, and desks provide rigid controls. Table 16 summarizes the final composition.
blocks.zh: 基准涵盖在软接触、混合接触和硬接触之间常见的室内支持。 床和沙发强调符合要求的表面. 椅子和地毯造成混合接触。 壳、桌子和桌子提供严格的控制。 表16汇总了最后组成。

blocks.en: Table 16: Benchmark support-category split. Counts are prompt–asset–scene cases.
blocks.zh: 表16:基准支助类别划分。 计算为即时-资产-场景。

blocks.en: Prompts are written to exercise both semantic grounding and physical realization. The in-distribution set includes support-only prompts, sub-part prompts, orientation-sensitive prompts, and material/contact-sensitive prompts. Examples include “place a plush toy on the sofa,” “place a dumbbell on the center of the mattress,” and “place a book on the top shelf.” Each prompt is paired with an intended support. When needed, it also stores a target part and an anchor token.
blocks.zh: 提示书是用来进行语义定位和物理实现的。 内部分配集包括只支持的提示,子部分提示,定向敏感提示,以及材料/接触敏感提示. 例子包括“在沙发上放置一个加式玩具”、“在床垫中央放置一个哑铃”和“在顶端架上放置一本书”。 每个提示与预定支持对齐。 必要时,它也会存储一个目标部分和一个锚标.

blocks.en: The stress split is constructed separately. Feasible OOD prompts are unusual relative to the standard distribution but physically satisfiable under the reconstructed geometry and material assumptions. Infeasible prompts are annotated as unsupported, oversized, unstable, or impossible under the modeled scene. These cases test whether a method can reject invalid instructions rather than forcing every prompt into a placement.
blocks.zh: 压力分拆是分开构建的. 相对于标准分布来说,可行的OD提示是不寻常的,但在重建的几何学和物质假设下,物理上是可调和的. 不可行的提示被注解为不支持,体积过大,不稳定,或者在模型化的场景下不可能. 这些案例检验一种方法是否能够拒绝无效的指令,而不是强迫每个提示进入一个位置.

blocks.en: Labelers received clean scene views, reconstructed mesh views, an asset preview, the object category, and the prompt. They annotated each case before any method was run. They first selected the intended support instance from the fixed support vocabulary. They then marked a target part and anchor when the prompt specified one. If the prompt was coarse, they chose the most natural upward-facing region of the intended support.
blocks.zh: 标签收到干净的场景视图,重建网格视图,资产预览,对象类别,以及提示. 在采用任何方法之前,他们都会对每个案件作说明。 他们首先从固定支持词汇中选择了预定支持实例. 然后在提示指定时标记目标部分并锚定. 如果迅速性粗糙,他们选择了预定支援的最自然的向上区.

blocks.en: A feasible case had to satisfy three checks. The target support had to exist in the reconstructed mesh. The scaled object had to fit the target region. A stable resting state had to be plausible without hidden supports or impossible deformation. If any check failed, the case was labeled infeasible. The primary reason used one of six labels. The labels were unsupported target, oversized object, unstable support, missing geometry, ambiguous target, and contradictory instruction. Labelers never inspected outputs from DCAP or any baseline.
blocks.zh: 一个可行的案件必须满足三个检查要求。 目标支持必须存在于重建的网格中。 缩放对象必须适合目标区域. 一个稳定的休息状态必须是可信的,没有隐藏的支持或不可能变形。 如果检查失败, 案件就贴上了不可行的标签 。 主要原因使用了六个标签中的一个. 标签是无支持的目标,对象大小过大,支持不稳定,缺少几何,目标模糊,指令矛盾. 标签员从未检查过DCAP或任何基线的产出。

blocks.en: Contact regimes were assigned from the intended support and object material. Cases with mattresses, cushions, blankets, towels, clothing, or plush objects were marked soft when visible deformation was expected. Cases with both compliant and stiff contacts were marked mixed. Shelves, tables, desks, books, balls, and tabletop controls were marked rigid. Ambiguous cases were reviewed by a second labeler and resolved using the same mesh, prompt, and scale rules.
blocks.zh: 从预定的支助和实物材料中指定了联系制度。 床垫、衬垫、毯子、毛巾、衣物或外加物的病例,在预期明显变形时会标为软体。 既有合规接触也有僵硬接触的情况明显有好有坏。 壳,桌子,桌子,书本,球,以及台式电脑控件都标有刻板. 含糊不清的案件由第二名标签员审查,并采用同样的网格、迅速和比例尺规则加以解决。

blocks.zh: 表17列出了主要试验中使用的报告划分。

blocks.en: Table 17: Reporting splits and prompt-regime composition.
blocks.zh: 表17:报告分立和即时制度组成。

blocks.en: Each asset is assigned an object category, a canonical up direction when available, and a plausible real-world scale range. We normalize meshes to metric scale using category-level size priors and clamp the longest dimension. Assets are removed if their geometry is unusable for rendering or collision. For part-composed or deformable assets, semantic part labels are retained when available; otherwise, the asset receives a category-level material assignment. The same normalized scale is used for all methods.
blocks.zh: 每个资产被分配到一个对象类别,一个可用时的条形上升方向,以及一个合理的现实世界尺度范围。 我们使用类别大小前缀,将间距改为度量尺度,并限制最长的维度。 如果资产的几何特征无法用于渲染或碰撞,则予以删除。 对于部分组成或可变形的资产,在可用时保留语义部分的标签;否则,该资产收到类别级的物质转让. 所有方法都使用相同的标准尺度。

blocks.en: Each case receives a soft, mixed, or rigid contact-regime label. The label is determined from the intended support, object category, and material assignment. Soft cases are those where deformation should affect the visible resting state. Mixed cases include both stiff and compliant contact. Rigid cases involve supports where rigid settling is a reasonable approximation. The labels are used only for reporting; methods do not receive them as oracle inputs.
blocks.zh: 每个病例都得到软、混合或僵硬的接触制度标签。 标签根据预期支持、对象类别和物资分配确定。 软性病例是指变形应当影响可见休息状态的病例. 混合案件包括僵硬和合规的接触。 僵硬的案件涉及支持,因为僵硬的安置是一种合理的近似。 标签仅用于报告;方法不能作为甲骨文输入。

blocks.en: Each benchmark case stores the scene ID, object asset ID, prompt, intended support, target region when specified, anchor when specified, contact regime, feasibility label, and infeasibility reason. The same record stores the normalized object scale, the support instance used for evaluation, the canonical render views, and the diagnostic tolerances.
blocks.zh: 每个基准案例存储场景ID,对象资产ID,即时,意向支持,指定时目标区域,指定时锁定,联系制度,可行性标签,以及不可行性原因. 同样的记录存储了归一化的对象尺度,用于评价的支持实例,犬类渲染视图,以及诊断耐受性.

blocks.en: We use two reporting denominators. The 1,923-case standard split is used for aggregate placement quality, human/VLM preference, and physical diagnostics. The 140-case stress split is evaluated separately. Returned feasible placements on stress cases receive the same diagnostics as standard placements. Correct rejections count only in feasibility metrics because they do not have final placement states.
blocks.zh: 我们使用两个报告分母。 1,923个病例的标准分数用于总投放质量、人/VLM偏好和物理诊断。 140个案例的压力分担情况另行评估。 返回的在应激病例上可行的安置得到与标准安置相同的诊断。 正确的拒绝只算在可行性指标中,因为它们没有最终安置状态。

blocks.en: Benchmark construction is completed before running DCAP or any baseline. No method output is used to accept, reject, or relabel a case. All baselines receive the same prompt, object scale, scene mesh, and render views. Static baselines are evaluated for semantic placement, penetration, and support contact. Dynamic quantities are reported only for variants with an explicit physical rollout.
blocks.zh: 在运行DCAP或任何基线之前完成基准建设。 没有使用方法输出来接受、拒绝或重新标记一个案件。 所有基线都得到相同的即时,对象尺度,场景网,并给出视图. 对静态基线进行语义定位、插入和支持接触的评价。 仅报告有明确实体推出的变体的动态数量。

blocks.en: Appendix H Rendering Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录 H 渲染协议

blocks.en: All rendered comparisons use the same cameras, lighting, and object scale for every method on a case. The canonical VLM and human views are fixed before scoring: one prompt-facing overview, two oblique side views at ± 35 ∘ \pm 35^{\circ} , one elevated front view at 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} , and one support-level close-up centered on the target region. For qualitative figures, the same camera family is used, but crops are adjusted only to keep the object and support visible. Method names are removed from the images sent to the VLM evaluator and to human participants.
blocks.zh: 所有的比较都使用同样的相机,照明, 和对象尺度 对于每个方法在一个案件。 方舟VLM和人类观点在评分前是固定的:一个即时渲染的概览,两个偏斜的侧视图在±35\pm 35\circ},一个在±45\x45\crc}的提升前视图,以及一个以目标区域为中心的支持级特写. 对于定性数字,则使用相同的相机家族,但作物调整只是为了保持对象和支持的可见性. 从发给VLM评价员和人类参与者的图像中删除方法名称。

blocks.en: Appendix I Baselines and Reimplementation Details
blocks.zh: 基准和重新实施

blocks.en: I.1 FirePlace Reimplementation
blocks.zh: I.1 火场改造

blocks.en: The FirePlace-style baseline uses a language model to propose a support region. It samples candidate placements on upward-facing surfaces, filters candidates with excessive collision, and selects the best remaining candidate using a plausibility score. It uses the same object scale and scene assets as DCAP to isolate the effect of physical settling.
blocks.zh: FirePlace风格的基线使用语言模型提出一个支持区域. 它在向上浮的表面对候选人的安置进行抽样,过滤有过度碰撞的考生,并使用可信分数选择最佳的剩余考生. 它使用与DCAP相同的对象尺度和场景资产来隔离物理结算的效果.

blocks.en: I.2 LayoutGPT and Holodeck Adaptation
blocks.zh: I.2 布局GPT和Holodeck 适应

blocks.en: LayoutGPT and Holodeck outputs are mapped into the reconstructed scene coordinate frame by aligning axes and scale. If a method predicts abstract layout coordinates rather than mesh-surface anchors, the prediction is projected to the nearest valid support surface before rendering. We do not add deformable settling to these baselines unless it is explicitly reported as a hybrid variant. Table 19 summarizes the adaptation settings.
blocks.zh: 布局GPT和Holodeck输出通过对齐轴和尺度被映射到重建的场景坐标框中. 如果一种方法预测抽象布局坐标而不是网状表面锚,预测在渲染前被预测到最近的有效支持表面. 除非明确报告为混合变体,否则我们不会在这些基线中添加变形沉淀物。 表19总结了适应环境。

blocks.en: Participants compare two placements under a prompt. They also see the clean scene and the isolated object asset. The displayed axis is randomized between Right Place and Physics & Naturalness. Left/right order is randomized, and trials are balanced across method pairs. The interface uses the rendered panels described in Appendix H . Quality-control trials detect participants who ignore the prompt or consistently select physically impossible placements. Table 20 records the study counts and aggregation settings.
blocks.zh: 与会者比较了两个在即时安排的情况。 他们也看到了干净的场景和孤立的物体资产. 显示的轴在右侧位置和物理与自然之间随机排列. 左/右顺序随机排列,试验在方法对之间平衡. 界面使用附录H所述制成的面板。 质量控制试验发现参与者无视迅速或一贯选择物理上不可能的安置。 表20记录了研究的计数和汇总设置。

blocks.en: Appendix K VLM Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录 K VLM 评价协议

blocks.en: The VLM evaluator is gemini-3-pro-preview , while the upstream orientation and JSON modules use gpt-5.2 . This separation reduces direct evaluator–method coupling. The evaluator receives the prompt and the canonical renderings from Appendix H . It returns separate scores for Right Place and Physics & Naturalness, plus a short rationale. A separate pairwise prompt asks which of two results is better on the specified axis. Method order is randomized, method names are hidden, and the evaluator never receives diagnostic values such as penetration depth or residual speed.
blocks.zh: VLM评价员是Gemini-3-pro-review,而上游方向和JSON模块则使用gpt-5.2. 这种分离减少了直接评估方法的结合。 评估人员收到附录H中的即时和峡谷渲染。 它返回Right Place和Physics & Naturalness的单独分数,加上一个简短的理由. 一个单独的双向偶点询问在指定轴上两个结果中哪一个更好 。 方法顺序是随机的,方法名称是隐藏的,评估者从未收到渗透深度或剩余速度等诊断值.

blocks.en: Rubric excerpt. Right Place score 10 means the object is on the correct support, in the specified sub-region, and oriented consistently with the prompt. Physics & Naturalness score 10 means the object appears stably supported, the contact is plausible, the deformation matches the material, and no obvious floating or deep penetration is visible.
blocks.zh: 鲁字节选. Right Place分数 10 表示对象处于正确的支持上,位于指定的分区,方向与提示一致. 物理与自然分数 10 表示物体的外观被坚挺支持,接触是可信的,变形与材料相符,没有明显的浮入或深入可见.

blocks.en: Appendix L Additional Quantitative Metrics
blocks.zh: 附 录 L 定量计量

blocks.en: We compute diagnostics after final settling or after the baseline placement is rendered. • Penetration depth and fraction. We sample object-surface points and compute signed distance to S ~ b \widetilde{S}_{b} for rollout methods, or S b S_{b} for static baselines. We report the mean magnitude of negative distances in centimeters and the inside-support fraction; valid soft-support indentation is not counted as penetration. • Residual speed. We record rigid linear speed, equivalent angular surface speed, and particle speed at termination. The reported value is the maximum of these speeds in centimeters per second. • Target adherence. We project the final object center of mass onto the target support frame and measure its distance to the selected anchor, normalized by the base OBB diagonal. • Support contact. We estimate the fraction of near-contact object samples whose nearest support normal is upward-compatible. • Feasibility quality. For feasible and infeasible prompts, we report standard confusion-matrix rates.
blocks.zh: 我们在最后结算后或在基准放置后计算诊断结果。 • 渗透深度和分数。 我们对物体表面点进行取样,并计算到S~b\glasstilde{S}_{b}的签名距离,用于推出方法,或S b S_{b}用于静态基线。 我们报告在厘米内负距离和内部支持部分的平均值;有效的软支持缩进不算作渗透。 • 剩余速度。 我们记录刚性线性速度,等效角表面速度,以及终止时的粒子速度. 报告的值是这些速度的最大值,以每秒厘米计。 • 目标遵守。 我们将质量的最终物体中心投射到目标支持框架上,并测量其与选定锚的距离,由基座OBB对角实现常态化. • 支助联系。 我们估计了近接触对象样本中其最近的支持正常向上兼容的部分. • 可行性质量。 对于可行和不可行的提示,我们报告标准混淆率。

blocks.en: Penetration depth and fraction. We sample object-surface points and compute signed distance to S ~ b \widetilde{S}_{b} for rollout methods, or S b S_{b} for static baselines. We report the mean magnitude of negative distances in centimeters and the inside-support fraction; valid soft-support indentation is not counted as penetration.
blocks.zh: 渗透深度和分数. 我们对物体表面点进行取样,并计算到S~b\glasstilde{S}_{b}的签名距离,用于推出方法,或S b S_{b}用于静态基线。 我们报告在厘米内负距离和内部支持部分的平均值;有效的软支持缩进不算作渗透。

blocks.en: Residual speed. We record rigid linear speed, equivalent angular surface speed, and particle speed at termination. The reported value is the maximum of these speeds in centimeters per second.
blocks.zh: 残留速度。 我们记录刚性线性速度,等效角表面速度,以及终止时的粒子速度. 报告的值是这些速度的最大值,以每秒厘米计。

blocks.en: Target adherence. We project the final object center of mass onto the target support frame and measure its distance to the selected anchor, normalized by the base OBB diagonal.
blocks.zh: 目标遵守。 我们将质量的最终物体中心投射到目标支持框架上,并测量其与选定锚的距离,由基座OBB对角实现常态化.

blocks.en: Support contact. We estimate the fraction of near-contact object samples whose nearest support normal is upward-compatible.
blocks.zh: 支援联络 我们估计了近接触对象样本中其最近的支持正常向上兼容的部分.

blocks.en: Feasibility quality. For feasible and infeasible prompts, we report standard confusion-matrix rates.
blocks.zh: 可行性质量。 对于可行和不可行的提示,我们报告标准混淆率。

It also covers material ambiguity, particle-fill failure, and geometry defects. Non-convergence and true infeasibility form the final group. Each failure includes the prompt, predicted support/part/material, diagnostic flags, and the mitigation used or proposed.

blocks.en: Appendix P Broader Impacts
blocks.zh: 附录 P 宽度 影响

blocks.en: DCAP targets physically grounded synthetic placement. Misuse or deployment errors can affect embodied systems if simulated contacts are treated as real-world guarantees. Sim-to-real gaps in material parameters, reconstruction quality, or friction can lead to unsafe robot training data or incorrect manipulation policies. The benchmark also inherits biases from indoor scene datasets and asset repositories. Scene content, room layouts, object categories, and household materials may overrepresent some environments and underrepresent others. Source reconstructions and assets should be used under their original licenses and privacy constraints. Finally, plausible but physically wrong placements can mislead downstream embodied agents. We therefore report feasibility flags and objective diagnostics, and we recommend using DCAP outputs as simulation evidence rather than real-world safety guarantees.
blocks.zh: DCAP针对的是物理合成装置。 如果模拟接触被视为现实世界的保证,误用或部署错误会影响包含的系统。 在物质参数,重建质量,或摩擦方面的Sim-to-Real差距可能导致不安全的机器人训练数据或不正确的操纵政策. 该基准还继承了室内场景数据集和资产储存库的偏差。 场景内容,房间布局,物体类别,以及家庭材料可能过度代表一些环境,而不足代表另一些环境. 源头重建和资产应当在其原始许可证和隐私限制下使用。 最后,合理但实际错误的安置可能误导下游的代理商。 因此,我们报告可行性旗帜和客观的诊断结果,我们建议使用DCAP产出作为模拟证据,而不是现实世界的安全保障。
